facts.note: Félix states that when the temple bell struck nine, his watch showed twenty minutes to nine, and that his uncle made a scene about it in front of everyone.
"I went up to the library and stayed there alone." The brandy and his feelings are colour only.

At eighteen minutes past ten by his watch he heard a thump right above him in the atelier, and then the repeater: ten slow deep notes (counted), then doubled notes, then quick high ones he did not count.
At a quarter past ten by his watch someone went quickly up the stairs past the library door; at twenty-one minutes past ten someone came quickly down. He did not see who, and the door was shut.
Girard came in at thirty-two minutes past ten by his watch, and they sat together in the library until the temple struck eleven. The entry without knocking is manner, not a change to the facts.
